meta.description: A pointered callout for walkthroughs and contextual hints. Carries a header, a description, and three slots — ⤷ AssetSlot, ⤷ CloseSlot, ⤷ ActionSlot.

verdict.title: Ship as-is
verdict.text: Consolidates three sibling components — Onboarding - Tooltip, Tooltip Blurred and Transparent and Tooltip V2 — into one 24-variant set. Every issue raised against those three is resolved: the pointer is a vector, the close is a DS icon instance, the four pointer booleans became a single Placement enum, and content sits in three named Figma slots. Interaction states are carried by the Button and close icon and are assessed on those components. Code Connect mappings are left open for engineering to register.

overview.inContextNote: Contexts are illustrative. Tooltip sits above a dimmed cut-out during walkthroughs, and inline against a target element for contextual hints. The GBonds walkthrough screens in the Figma section show both.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: One component covers walkthrough coach-marks and inline hints across both surfaces. 24 variants span every text, placement and appearance combination with no gaps.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Carries its own surface, border, radius, padding and pointer. Height is a hug — Details takes the taller of the 46px asset slot and the text stack, so emptying a slot shrinks the card.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: One vocabulary end to end: the Text axis reads Header / Description / Both and the layers are #header / #description. All three slots use the ⤷ …Slot convention shared with the Table family.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Composes DS parts rather than redrawing them — the close is an icon instance and the CTA is a real Button - XSmall, both inside named slots a consumer can swap or empty.

behavior.notes: Tooltip is a presentation surface with no interaction states of its own. Tap and pressed behaviour belong to the Button - XSmall in ⤷ ActionSlot and the close icon in ⤷ CloseSlot.

resolved.headline: Three sibling Tooltips folded into one component.
resolved.body: Onboarding - Tooltip, Tooltip Blurred and Transparent and Tooltip V2 are gone. The section now holds a single Tooltip set, and the visual treatment that shipped as its own component is now Appearance=Translucent.

resolved.headline: Pointer direction is a single enum.
resolved.body: The four independent booleans on Tooltip V2, and the conflicting pointer schema on Onboarding - Tooltip, are replaced by Placement = Top | Bottom | Left | Right. Geometry follows: 24 × 12 on the vertical placements, 12 × 24 on the horizontal ones.

resolved.headline: Pointer is a vector, not a raster.
resolved.body: All three predecessors shipped the triangle as a raster asset. It is now a real vector — a filled path plus a rounded stroke — that recolours per appearance and rotates per placement.

resolved.headline: Close is a DS icon instance.
resolved.body: Previously an image asset on two of the three siblings. It is now an icon instance sitting in ⤷ CloseSlot.

resolved.headline: Content sits in named slots.
resolved.body: The missing body and CTA support is resolved by three Figma slots — ⤷ AssetSlot (46 × 46), ⤷ CloseSlot (16 × 16) and ⤷ ActionSlot holding a real Button - XSmall. The leading gray placeholder circle is now the slot default rather than baked artwork.

resolved.headline: One vocabulary across property, layer and content.
resolved.body: The Text axis, the layer names and the slot names were reconciled in the same pass — Header / Description / Both, #header / #description, and the ⤷ …Slot convention shared with Table.

recommendations.headline: Document the dismiss contract and walkthrough lifecycle.
recommendations.body: Tooltip renders a close affordance but owns no dismiss behaviour. Write down who dismisses it, whether dismissal advances a walkthrough step, and what happens to the backdrop cut-out — otherwise each consumer invents it. No Figma change required.

recommendations.headline: Fold Tooltip into the library-wide slot naming rule.
recommendations.body: Tooltip now follows the Table family convention (⤷ AssetSlot, ⤷ CloseSlot, ⤷ ActionSlot), making it two families to one against the carousel components’ unsuffixed form. Table already carries an open recommendation to write a single rule into the guidelines — this component should be named in it.

accessibility.ios: .accessibilityElement(children: .combine) on the container — header then description.
Close is a Button with accessibilityLabel("Dismiss"); the 16 pt glyph gets a 44 pt hit area; .accessibilityAction(.escape) also dismisses.
accessibility.android: IconButton with contentDescription = "Dismiss" and a 48 dp touch target; back press dismisses.

accessibility.ios: Header, description, then Next, then Dismiss — a walkthrough moves focus to the next tooltip after Next.
accessibility.android: Same order; request focus on the new tooltip after Next.

accessibility.ios: Opaque: #0A2757 on white (13.9:1); Translucent: white on #0A2757 (13.9:1), description at 80% still 9.4:1.
accessibility.android: Same values — the surfaces are fixed, not themed.

usageGuidelines.doText: Point Placement at the anchor and keep the 336 px container inside the safe area.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t let the pointer sit over the anchor’s edge — move the tooltip, not the pointer.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Translucent over imagery and dimmed walkthrough backdrops.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use Translucent on a plain white screen; Opaque is the default there.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Text Both for walkthrough steps, Header alone for a one-line hint.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t exceed one line in the header; the description is the place for detail.

usageGuidelines.doText: Fill ⤷ ActionSlot with the Next step of a walkthrough.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t put a destructive action in the slot.

scorecard.notes: Container › Details › ⤷ AssetSlot / Text Container / ⤷ CloseSlot, ⤷ ActionSlot, pointer-adjustment — read on 6295:79678. The slots keep the ⤷ glyph and the text layers the # sigil that the rest of the system has dropped.
#header → Primary/Headlines/Block, #description → Secondary/Bold/Caption. Colour variable bindings are not readable with the plugin — confirm in Dev Mode.
Three enums, three slots, two strings — maps 1:1 onto EBTooltip.
Interaction lives on the Button - XSmall and the Close icon and is assessed there.
The pointer is a vector and the asset a swappable instance; the Close icon carries a shape_full BOOLEAN_OPERATION — flatten it in the icon library.

changelog.header: Style and Code tabs re-read · node 6295:79647

rows.body: Style tab rebuilt from the 24 live variants. Cards follow Appearance — Opaque, Translucent — with Text and Placement as panel controls and the three slots drawn filled as Figma ships them; the asset placeholder is now the solid #D7E0EF instance and the Close the library glyph. Padding, gap, alignment and colour tokens are not readable with the plugin and stay —.

Code tab regrouped on the three-property schema. Property Mapping one row per property with the three slots, Usage Snippets per Appearance, Guidelines trimmed to four, Scorecard regraded, Variants Inventory on the 24 live nodes with a summary and collapsed breakdown.

Layer names keep the retired glyph and sigil. ⤷ AssetSlot, ⤷ CloseSlot, ⤷ ActionSlot, #header and #description on 6295:79678 predate the family convention (-Slot suffix, no sigil). Filed from the scorecard for the Component Review.

Three components became one — Onboarding - Tooltip, Tooltip Blurred and Transparent and Tooltip V2 are superseded by this 24-variant set. Their pages are retained as remove stubs pointing here. Documented
Pointer booleans became an enum — four independent booleans replaced by Placement = Top | Bottom | Left | Right. Resolved
Raster assets replaced — the pointer is a vector path that recolours per appearance and rotates per placement; the close is a DS icon instance. Resolved
Content moved into named slots — ⤷ AssetSlot, ⤷ CloseSlot and ⤷ ActionSlot, the last holding a real Button - XSmall. Resolved

Naming reconciled post-consolidation — Text values recased to Header / Description / Both, the wrapper frame unified to Text Container, layers renamed to #header / #description, Appearance changed from Onboarding to Opaque, and the slots adopted the ⤷ …Slot convention. Resolved
Interaction states delegated — Tooltip is a presentation surface; pressed and disabled are carried by the Button and close icon and assessed there. Reassigned
Code Connect mappings not registered — left open for engineering. Open
